title: Incident management: one decision trace
teachingQuestion: What does incident management require beyond completing a technical action?
focalInsight: Coordinate authority, evidence, containment, communications and validated recovery; use lessons to improve prevention and readiness.
caption: Follow the concept from meaning to the decision condition and its concrete failure consequence.

nodes.label: Incident management
